note: Per-screen RMSE ceilings for Tools/snapshot/compare.sh. `file` is the reference PNG in Reference/, `threshold` the normalised RMSE the capture must stay under. Both images are normalised to 393x852 pt before comparing. By default the status bar (top 54 pt) and home indicator (bottom 34 pt) are masked; a `crop` (WxH+X+Y in pt on the normalised image) compares only that region instead, and a `refCrop` (WxH+X+Y in the reference's own pixels) cuts a phone-frame mockup down to its screen window before that. Thresholds start from Reference/manifest.json. A screen that is deliberately not a pixel match any more carries a raised threshold and a `notes` entry saying why; Reference/scores.md is the ledger of those and must agree with this file.

onboarding-slide1.notes: phone-frame mockup of reader + verse action sheet; alt state onboarding-slide1-deepstudy.png Phase 4h: the phone frame is now the iPhone 17 Pro drawn from device metrics (402x874 pt glass, 55 pt radius, 6 pt black border, 2.5 pt titanium rail, side buttons, ground shadow) with the whole capture fitted into it — nothing cropped. Accepted deviation: the reference's bezel is a stylised 10.6 pt where the hardware's is 4.7, so the reference's body is 243.3 pt wide against our 234.2, and ~4.6 pt of black bezel down each side and ~6 pt top and bottom read as screen content in ours. The enclosure's own silhouette (rows 238...736) and the screen window's registration are matched; the residue is bezel thickness, which cannot be matched without drawing a phone no iPhone looks like.

paywall-trial.notes: Phase 4e accepted deviation: the brand mark is 72 pt square anchored to the safe-area top, where the reference draws it 58x54 at y 47 — that y is behind the Dynamic Island on every island device. The mark is the only element that moved; the extra height comes out of the gap above the headline. Costs ~0.007 RMSE.

gift-closed.notes: Phase 4f: the envelope is the generated photoreal render (Artwork/Gift/envelope-closed-1200x900.png, cut by Artwork/tools/gift-assets.sh), on the generated sky. Accepted deviations, 0.0424 against the 0.0292 the vector art scored: (a) the sky is a real cumulus render toned to the reference's own band (mean 227.8/221.6/203.8, sd 7.4/9.0/13.7) but its clouds are where the render put them, not where the reference's are, which is most of the residue; (b) the render is 1.46:1 where the reference's envelope is 1.54:1, and width is matched, so ours is ~8 pt taller; (c) the wax seal carries the app's own arabesque ring instead of the reference's crown of thorns (Phase 4e), baked into the render.

gift-open.notes: Phase 4f: sky -> EnvelopeOpen (1000x1500, flap stretched x1.85 above the pocket line) -> EnvelopeCard clipped at the pocket's mouth -> WaxSealLogo, all from Artwork/tools/gift-assets.sh. The offer copy is unchanged from Phase 4e (OFF pill 69x33 at y 270 with a 3.3 pt outline). Accepted deviations, 0.0625 against the vector art's 0.0346: (a) the same cumulus sky as gift-closed; (b) the render's front pocket is shallower than the reference's, so the pocket's top corners land at y 379 where the reference's are at 338 and the envelope's bottom edge at 579 is matched instead; (c) the render models its faces (lit front pocket, shaded flap lining) where the reference's envelope is nearly flat; (d) the seal carries the app's own ring. Phase 4h: the OFF pill moves from y 270 to 278 so it sits under the digits' baseline instead of across it (owner: “the OFF under 33% needs to be moved down a bit”); measured 0.0654 against 0.0624.

discover-dark.notes: opaque tab bar; Phase 4i accepted deviations (owner's amendment 2 and the fixed-slot amendment): no KJV/ITANI translation badge under the title, no muted Arabic line, and a quote slot fixed at four lines where the reference draws three — so MEANING and everything under it sit about 21 pt lower than the reference while the card's own edges (14.15 % / 83.9 % of the screen) match it. Scores 0.0362 against 0.14, better than the 0.0592 it scored before, so the threshold is unchanged. Phase 4m (owner: “ideally the entirety of the verse fits on the card. the meaning/did you know can be cut off”): the quote is no longer a four-line slot but as many lines as the passage needs, and MEANING and DID YOU KNOW divide what is left of the same body budget. The card's height and every row from the cross-reference chips down are unchanged; card 0's quote goes from four elided lines to six and its MEANING from four lines to two, which reads as residue against the reference's short passage. Scores 0.0381 against 0.14, threshold unchanged.

plans-sheet.notes: phone-frame mockup. Accepted deviation (Phase 4b): the residue is plan cover artwork. The reference is Scroll the Bible, whose covers are licensed stock photographs; ours are the generated covers in App/Assets.xcassets, which is frozen after Phase 1 and outside this task's ownership. Under the sigma-6 blur the score is dominated by those tone blocks, not by layout. Phase 3c measured 0.193 with the layout matched and Phase 4b measures 0.1927: header, search field, active-plan card, section header and the 2-up cover grid all land on the reference. The other half of the residue is iOS dimming the parent black behind the sheet where the reference shows it grey. Phase 4k: photographic covers and 18 plans; measures 0.1995, ceiling 0.22. Needs SCROLL_CAPTURE_SETTLE >= 12 on a cold simulator or the sheet is captured before it presents. Phase 4l: the cover crop is anchored on each slug's subject (FeatureHome/PlanCoverFocal.swift) instead of the frame's centre; same assets, same sizes, only the window moved. Measures 0.2035 — up ~0.004 because the reference's covers are different photographs, so an off-centre window puts our subject's luminance where the reference has sky or wall. Ceiling unchanged.
